name: What is the best way to compare luxury home design bids?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare multiple luxury home design proposals fairly in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: How do I compare multiple luxury home design proposals fairly in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury design proposals should be compared by total value, not by headline fee alone. Two bids can look similar but include very different scopes. One may cover only concept design, while another includes detailed specifications, trade sourcing, procurement, site visits, and installation coordination. Ask exactly what deliverables are included, how many revisions are allowed, whether purchasing is handled in-house, and whether the designer coordinates with the architect and contractor. For Los Angeles projects, experience with local construction realities also matters because site conditions, permit issues, and custom fabrication can affect decisions. A lower fee can end up costing more if it leaves gaps that the homeowner must fill later. The best comparison method is to line up the proposals side by side and check scope, timeline, and responsibilities. That makes it much easier to see which team is actually equipped for a luxury project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare proposals by scope, deliverables, team experience, procurement support, revision limits, and project management, not just price. A lower bid may exclude key services like sourcing, installation, or coordination, which can make it more expensive later. The best proposal is the one that matches the project’s real complexity.
